mapper.sql: select e.experiment_id, e.experiment_name, e.experiment_type, e.platform, e.metric, e.variants, e.min_sample, e.max_days, e.alpha, e.status, e.winner_code, e.result, e.start_time, e.end_time, e.evaluated_time, e.conclude_reason, e.create_by, e.create_time, e.update_by, e.update_time, e.remark, (select count(*) from abr_experiment_unit u where u.experiment_id = e.experiment_id) as unit_count from abr_experiment e
mapper.select: where e.status in ('running', 'ready') order by e.experiment_id
where e.experiment_type = #{type} and e.platform = #{platform} and e.status = 'running' limit 1
where e.experiment_type = #{type} and e.platform = #{platform} and e.status = 'concluded' and e.winner_code is not null order by e.end_time desc, e.experiment_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into abr_experiment (experiment_name, experiment_type, platform, metric, variants, min_sample, max_days, alpha, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{experimentName}, #{experimentType}, #{platform}, #{metric}, cast(#{variants} as jsonb), #{minSample}, #{maxDays}, #{alpha}, 'draft', #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update abr_experiment set experiment_name = #{experimentName}, platform = #{platform}, metric = #{metric}, variants = cast(#{variants} as jsonb), min_sample = #{minSample}, max_days = #{maxDays}, alpha = #{alpha}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where experiment_id = #{experimentId} and status = 'draft'
mapper.delete: delete from abr_experiment where status = 'draft' and experiment_id in #{id}
mapper.update: update abr_experiment set status = 'running', start_time = now(), update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where experiment_id = #{id} and status = 'draft'

update abr_experiment set status = 'stopped', end_time = now(), conclude_reason = #{reason}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where experiment_id = #{id} and status in ('running', 'ready')

update abr_experiment set status = 'concluded', winner_code = #{winner}, end_time = now(), conclude_reason = #{reason}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where experiment_id = #{id} and status in ('running', 'ready')
update abr_experiment set result = cast(#{result} as jsonb), evaluated_time = now() , status = #{status}, conclude_reason = #{reason} where experiment_id = #{id} and status in ('running', 'ready')
mapper.insert: insert into abr_experiment_unit (experiment_id, unit_type, unit_id, variant_code, create_time) values (#{experimentId}, #{unitType}, #{unitId}, #{variant}, now()) on conflict (experiment_id, unit_type, unit_id) do nothing
mapper.select: with per as ( select u.variant_code, c.content_id, (select sum(cast(r.metrics ->> 'views' as bigint)) from abr_publish_record r where r.content_id = c.content_id and r.status = 'published' and r.metrics ->> 'views' is not null) as views, (select count(*) from abr_visitor v where v.content_code = c.content_code and v.merged_into is null and v.del_flag = '0') as visitors, (select count(*) from abr_visitor v where v.content_code = c.content_code and v.merged_into is null and v.del_flag = '0' and (exists (select 1 from abr_tool_run t where t.visitor_id = v.visitor_id) or exists (select 1 from abr_assessment s where s.visitor_id = v.visitor_id and s.submitted_time is not null))) as tool_visitors from abr_experiment_unit u join abr_content c on c.content_id = u.unit_id where u.experiment_id = #{experimentId} and u.unit_type = 'content' ) select variant_code, count(*) as contents, coalesce(sum(views), 0) as views, coalesce(sum(visitors) filter (where views is not null), 0) as visitors_with_views, coalesce(sum(visitors), 0) as visitors, coalesce(sum(tool_visitors), 0) as tool_visitors from per group by variant_code
select report_id, week_start, null as data, narrative, ai_status, ai_call_id, create_by, create_time, update_time from abr_growth_report order by week_start desc
select report_id, week_start, data, narrative, ai_status, ai_call_id, create_by, create_time, update_time from abr_growth_report where report_id = #{reportId}
select report_id, week_start, data, narrative, ai_status, ai_call_id, create_by, create_time, update_time from abr_growth_report where week_start = cast(#{weekStart} as date)
mapper.insert: insert into abr_growth_report (week_start, data, narrative, ai_status, ai_call_id, create_by, create_time) values (#{weekStart}, cast(#{data} as jsonb), cast(#{narrative} as jsonb), #{aiStatus}, #{aiCallId}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.sql: select g.log_id, g.param_key, g.scope, p.playbook_name as scope_name, g.old_value, g.new_value, g.reason, g.status, g.report_id, g.create_by, g.create_time, g.update_by, g.update_time from abr_growth_param_log g left join abr_playbook p on p.playbook_code = g.scope
mapper.insert: insert into abr_growth_param_log (param_key, scope, old_value, new_value, reason, status, report_id, create_by, create_time) values (#{paramKey}, #{scope}, cast(#{oldValue} as jsonb), cast(#{newValue} as jsonb), #{reason}, #{status}, #{reportId}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update abr_growth_param_log set status = #{to}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where log_id = #{id} and status = #{from}
mapper.select: select count(*) from abr_growth_param_log where report_id = #{reportId} and param_key = #{paramKey}
select playbook_code, playbook_name, cast(content_mix as text) as content_mix from abr_playbook where status = '0' order by priority desc, playbook_id
select cast(content_mix as text) from abr_playbook where playbook_code = #{playbookCode}
mapper.update: update abr_playbook set content_mix = cast(#{mix} as jsonb), update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where playbook_code = #{code}
mapper.select: with c as ( select distinct c.content_id, c.content_code, c.content_kind from abr_content c join abr_publish_record r on r.content_id = c.content_id and r.status = 'published' where coalesce(r.published_time, r.planned_time) >= cast(#{beginDate} as date) and coalesce(r.published_time, r.planned_time) < cast(#{endDate} as date) + interval '1 day' ) select c.content_kind, count(distinct c.content_id) as contents, count(distinct v.visitor_id) filter (where exists (select 1 from abr_tool_run t where t.visitor_id = v.visitor_id) or exists (select 1 from abr_assessment s where s.visitor_id = v.visitor_id and s.submitted_time is not null)) as tool_users from c left join abr_visitor v on v.content_code = c.content_code and v.merged_into is null and v.del_flag = '0' group by c.content_kind

select rule_code, scope, coalesce(agent_code, '') as agent_code, coalesce(account_code, '') as account_code, action, to_char(create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as trip_time from abr_breaker_trip where create_time >= cast(#{beginDate} as date) and create_time < cast(#{endDate} as date) + interval '1 day' order by trip_id
